#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

DEST='backup-srv:/srv/nightly'
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"
SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
BUNDLE_PATH="$SCRIPT_DIR/$BUNDLE"

# Use the script's directory so this also works when cron starts it elsewhere.
tar -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" -czf "$BUNDLE_PATH" logs/
scp "$BUNDLE_PATH" "$DEST/$BUNDLE"

echo "wrote $BUNDLE_PATH and copied it to $DEST/$BUNDLE"

arguments.command:
set -eu
ls -l backup.sh
sh -n backup.sh
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"; rm -f "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"' EXIT
cat > "$tmpdir/scp" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$SCP_ARGS_FILE"
EOF
chmod +x "$tmpdir/scp"
export SCP_ARGS_FILE="$tmpdir/scp-args"
PATH="$tmpdir:$PATH" ./backup.sh
test -f "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
tar -tzf "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz" | grep -qx 'logs/app.log'
tar -tzf "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz" | grep -qx 'logs/error.log'
printf '%s\n' '--- scp args ---'
cat "$SCP_ARGS_FILE"
